author: claude
text:
gate: alignment verified

ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1 defines all primary terms; banned-term list is explicit.
Grepped for bare 'call', 'turn', 'session', 'compression', 'chat'; only remnants
are inside the banned-usage note itself and the §5.1 cross-reference to the
LangChain write/select/compress/isolate taxonomy (where 'compress' is quoted
in that external sense). Tool/Skill split, provider disambiguation, pass@1
metric — all traceable to TAXONOMY.md sections.

Residual (acceptable) terms not in §2.1 but taxonomy-defined or generic:
- 'trace' (§2.1 mentions; TAXONOMY §7).
- 'fork' (§7.2) — standard git, parenthetically explained.
- 'procedure' (§6) — defined inline as subordinate routines.
- 'worker', 'verifier', 'compactor' — agent role names, config-level identifiers.
